workarounds.note: parseTSV leaves headerRowCount unset, so the wine list's head row is declared by hand; the region rows are merged with mergeCells, which marks the covered cells hiddenBy

an inline table gets a grid line above it and only the snap leftover below, which is nothing here because each course ends on a grid line. The notes and colophon paragraph styles carry a marginTop of one line; without it the notes start on the line after the last dessert

headings.levels[0].breakBefore states the H1 break off, because the name and La Cave stay on the page of the drawing above them; with the always-odd default restored each drawing stands alone on a page and the card runs to seven pages
the course-head title's lineHeight is a multiple of its size, 0.96 (14.4 pt), so the design stays inside one 14.5 pt grid line
each course-head rule states its thickness, 0.75 pt: a rule element without one paints nothing, although the docs give 0.5 pt as the default

the colophon is a centred paragraph style after the last table rather than that table's note, because 1.4.1 sets caption and note lines flush left with the column whatever captionStyle.align and captionStyle.note.align say

every line on the card is centred or set in a table cell, and 1.4.1 hyphenates justified body text only, so the config sets no locale and each dish and translation is written short enough to stay on one line of its cell

what.en: The awning and the shelf of bottles, drawn in code in the page's palette
what.es: El toldo y el estante de botellas, dibujados en código con la paleta de la página
